text:
The photo shows a bowl of porridge, likely congee or oatmeal, with a few brown bits on top. The bowl looks about 15–16 cm across, so it probably holds roughly 300 g of porridge.

If it is rice congee, it runs about 50–70 kcal per 100 g. Oatmeal cooked in water is about 70 kcal per 100 g. This looks thick, so I used about 65 kcal per 100 g.

300 g × 0.65 ≈ 195 kcal. I rounded up to 200 kcal to allow for the toppings.
